jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Raleigh
jobs.description:
About Us:
 
Versana is an industry-backed data and technology company on a mission to make the syndicated loan market better. By digitally capturing agent banks’ data on a real-time basis and centralizing it onto a single platform, Versana provides unprecedented transparency into loan level details and portfolio positions, bringing efficiency and velocity to the entire market. Through our platform, participants can rest assured they are accessing the loan market’s most credible source of deal information.
 
About You:
 
The Engineering Manager is a strategic and operational leader responsible for driving high-performing engineering teams, enabling technical excellence, and delivering high-impact products and platforms. This role partners closely with Product, Architecture, and cross-functional stakeholders to define technical strategy, mature engineering practices, and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery. The ideal candidate is both a strong people manager and a seasoned technologist who can elevate engineering capabilities across the organization.
 
Responsibilities:
 
People Leadership & Team Development
·       Lead, mentor, and develop engineering managers, tech leads, and individual contributors across multiple teams.
·       Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
·       Drive career growth frameworks, performance management, and succession planning.
·       Foster an inclusive, high-trust environment that supports well-being and sustained productivity.
 
Technical Leadership & Execution
·       Provide strategic technical direction in partnership with architecture and product leadership.
·       Guide teams in designing scalable, secure, and high-quality systems aligned with long-term business goals.
·       Champion engineering best practices, including code quality, observability, automation, and DevOps maturity.
·       Lead efforts to modernize technology, simplify architecture, and reduce technical debt.
 
Operational Excellence
·       Establish and monitor KPIs for engineering performance, quality, and reliability.
·       Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the engineering organization.
·       Optimize team structures, resource allocations, and processes for scale.
·       Oversee vendor or contract engineering relationships when relevant.
 
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration
·       Act as a senior partner to Product, Design, Data, Security, and Infrastructure teams.
·       Communicate technical decisions, trade-offs, and risks clearly to executive leadership.
·       Ensure engineering alignment with organizational goals and compliance requirements.
·       Additional duties and responsibilities as may be reasonably assigned from time to time as operational needs evolve. 
·       Periodically work outside standard business hours, such as during infrastructure upgrades and/or releases.
 
Must Haves:
 
·       8+ years of engineering experience 
·       Proven track record scaling engineering teams and delivering complex, high-impact software systems.
·       Strong technical foundation in software architecture, cloud technologies, and modern development practices.
·       Demonstrated ability to balance technical depth with strategic leadership.
·       Exceptional communication, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
·       Experience in a matrix organization with both direct and dotted-line structures.
·       Background working in Agile environments—Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid models.
·       Familiarity with platform engineering, developer experience tooling, or productivity enablement.
 
 
Additional Information
 
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals in this role.  It is not intended to create a contract of employment for any specific duration of time or on any set or fixed terms. Employment with Versana is at‑will, meaning that either the employee or the Company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.  This role is designed and expected to be classified as exempt under applicable law. 
 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer
 
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Among other things, Versana will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities and sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable law.
 
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Technical Lead - Application Development - Raleigh
jobs.description:
About Us:
 
Versana is an industry-backed data and technology company on a mission to make the syndicated loan market better. By digitally capturing agent banks’ data on a real-time basis and centralizing it onto a single platform, Versana provides unprecedented transparency into loan level details and portfolio positions, bringing efficiency and velocity to the entire market. Through our platform, participants can rest assured they are accessing the loan market’s most credible source of deal information.
 
About You: 
 
Versana is looking for a highly motivated Technical Lead to guide our Application Development team’s technical implementation of Versana’s real-time syndicated loan platform. The platform delivers a streamlined interface that provides clients with secure, real-time access to loan data, analytics, and positions.
 
As Technical Lead, you’ll work closely with seasoned engineers, product and project managers, and UX designers to drive the technical direction, ensure delivery excellence, and foster a culture of innovation and collaboration. You must have a strong technical foundation in full-stack engineering, a passion for scalable design, and a hands-on approach to mentorship and problem-solving.
 
You will play a pivotal role in shaping one of Versana’s product verticals—leading the design and delivery of performant, secure, and intuitive applications that set a new standard for the syndicated loan market.
 
Key Responsibilities:
 
Technical Delivery
·       In collaboration with Architects, oversee the technical direction  
·       Drive successful delivery of solutions, ensuring quality, performance, and scalability.
·       Collaborate with Product and UX teams to translate client needs into high-impact, high-visibility solutions.
·       Build test automation across the full stack of our software and enforce engineering best practices.
·       Optimize application performance and reliability in a cloud environment.
 
Technical Leadership
·       Serve as the technical authority and primary point of contact for the squad.
·       Guide architectural discussions, code reviews, and implementation decisions.
·       Ensure adherence to coding standards, architectural principles, and security best practices.
·       Identify and introduce new tools and frameworks to improve team efficiency and product quality.
·       Establish and evolve the technical foundation and culture for the Application Development squad.
 
Collaboration & Communication
·       Partner with Product Managers and Technical Project Managers to define scope, timelines, and priorities.
·       Communicate project status, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders clearly and proactively.
·       Collaborate with other leads to ensure alignment across squads and technical domains.
 
Mentorship & Team Development
·       Provide day-to-day technical mentorship, unblock challenges, and foster a culture of continuous learning.
·       Help onboard and support new engineers, ensuring consistent growth and high engagement.
·       Collaborate with People Managers to identify development opportunities and provide performance feedback.
·       Discover ways to increase team productivity and efficiency through improved processes and tooling.
·       Additional duties and responsibilities as may be reasonably assigned from time to time as operational needs evolve. 
·       Periodically work outside standard business hours, such as during infrastructure upgrades and/or releases.
 
 
Must Have:
 
·       BS or BA in Computer Science or related field.
·       10+ years of full-stack development experience (Java/Spring Boot backend and React/Angular with TypeScript/JavaScript frontend).
·       Strong understanding of application architecture, design patterns, and performance optimization.
·       Proven experience leading technical projects or teams in an agile environment.
·       Proficiency with REST APIs, GraphQL, and database technologies (SQL and NoSQL).
·       Hands-on experience with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD pipelines.
·       Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
·       Curiosity and willingness to learn, teach, and grow within a collaborative team environment.
 
Nice to Have:
 
·       Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud computing platforms.
·       Experience with end-to-end testing frameworks (Playwright, Selenium, Cucumber, etc.).
·       Exposure to advanced UI frameworks, charting libraries, or design systems (AG Grid, D3, etc.).
·       Familiarity with accessibility and responsive design principles.
·       Experience in financial services, particularly syndicated loans or leveraged finance.
·       Track record of building scalable enterprise applications within a regulated domain.
 
 
Additional Information

jobs.title: Global Product Director, 3D Printing
jobs.description:
Be yourself at Protolabs 
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification.  We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse team that feels they are valued in the workplace.  So do you feel you do not meet every single requirement but still intrigued? We encourage you to still apply!  You can help make our company even better.  We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, age, mental or physical ability, or any way you represent yourself.  We strongly believe diversity makes for more successful teams. 
 
Why Protolabs? 
We are the leaders in digital manufacturing.  We hire doers, makers, and creative thinkers who tackle our roles with an entrepreneurial spirit.  Our culture is centered around meaningful work that brings new and innovative products to market at unprecedented speeds.  We are a diverse team that comes from all walks of life and take pride in our team who is smart, genuine, humble, and passionate about what we do.  It’s our people who fuel our creativity and make our culture feel like home. 


Join Our Team as Global Product Director, 3D Printing!
We are accepting applications from candidates based in Minnesota or North Carolina. This is a hybrid role based in our Maple Plain, MN, or Raleigh, NC office, with on-site work expected on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.
The Global Product Director,3D Printing is a strategic and data-driven role responsible for leading, managing and directing the product-related activities within the 3D Printing (Additive Manufacturing) Product Line.This role is responsible for proactive management of Protolabs' 3D Printing offering across the full range of additive technologies and materials.
 
The successful candidate will work closely with operations, engineering and R&D, sales, marketing and leadership to maximize the growth, development and return on investment of the organization's product portfolio today and in the future. At its core, this role owns the strategy and the business plans' implementation for all 3D Printing offerings and is jointly accountable for their profitability with the sales and operations.The Global Product Director leads and directs the 3D Printing product team, translating deep additive manufacturing expertise and product strategy into scalable, repeatable go-to-market execution that accelerates adoption across segments and regions.
 
This role reports into the Chief Technology and AI Officer.
